race.description: Ladbrokes Flex Your Multi Stays Alive Mdn Plate
race.comment: NINE CHOIRS (10) was tried in front last start over 1400m, and was only claimed late, finishing fifth, less than 2 lengths from the winner. Dropping back to 1200m will help, and she has top 4 claims. THE RED SHE DEVIL (13) has a few tricks up her sleeve, and having Craig Newitt in the saddle for the first time is a nice positive. The winkers go on, and she is open to further improvement. FROSTY RUGE (8) ran her best race yet fresh up here nearly 4 weeks ago, and she gets a big swing with her draw, and is well worth including in all top 4 combos again. GYM PRINCESS (9) resumes from a spell, and will be a lot stronger now. A good draw, and a 2kg claim will ensure that she is competitive fresh up. MR TOD (4) just peaked late fresh up, and he will be a sharp improver with that run out of the way.
